caption: The drawing features two objects. At the top center is a fully opened handheld fan with a circular, pleated surface composed of alternating light and darker blue sections, edged with a thin yellow outline. The fan has a brown, elongated, teardrop-shaped handle with a pink string or tassel attached at the bottom. Below the open fan is a depiction of the fan in its closed state, showing a brown, rectangular cover or case with a matching handle protruding to the right, also adorned with a pink string or tassel. The background is a plain, light beige.
title: Fan
